description:
This position, based in the United States, is responsible for driving stable operational performance, yield improvement, and manufacturing continuity at external subcontractors for (Onsemi). Serving as the focal point between the External Manufacturing team and the Business Unit (BU), this role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders and subcontractor teams to execute the following responsibilities:

  

 Core Responsibilities :

 Lead strategic projects focused on operational excellence, value engineering, and quality improvement.

 Act as the communication bridge among suppliers, customers, BU, and project teams for operations management, program management, and risk awareness

 Manage external manufacturing operations, driving quality, yield, delivery, cost, and supplier performance.

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field

 10+ years of experience in semiconductor industry, preferably in assembly/backend manufacturing operations

 Proven experience in high-volume, high-mix production environment

 Project management skills and proven experience are required

 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving skills

 Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with global teams

 Proficiency in BI Tools, Python and SQL would be advantageous

 
 onsemi  (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world.
 


 
 
 


 
 More details about our company benefits can be found here:
